description: This file declares the class `controller_ucc_listener` which is a specialized listener for UCC (Unified Control Center) messages in the prplMesh controller component. It includes method declarations for handling various device commands, managing configurations, and converting radio preferences. The class interacts with the database and UCC server components, and handles commands related to device settings and wireless configurations.

classes.name: controller_ucc_listener
classes.description: A class that handles UCC protocol messages for the prplMesh controller, managing device configurations and wireless preferences.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with references to the database, CMDU transmitter, and UCC server.

methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to a specified destination.
